verdict.rationale: Trello's docs describe tracking tasks as cards and creating cards, including by email. They also cover due dates on cards, set from the card title, and on checklist items. Community users corroborate the card-based task workflow and an easy 'add people' feature. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of assigning card members/teammates to specific tasks, in-depth docs on core card creation rather than Power-Up feature lists, independent hands-on confirmation of assignment-with-due-date workflows.
